name: Nethfell
description: Nethfell burns at the edge of charted space, its light reaching survey scopes long before any hull. Its worlds formed late from enriched debris, and their crusts still carry the ratio of that violent birth. One moon occults on a schedule that matches no ephemeris, and navigators plan around it.

stars.name: Hollow Pyre
stars.description: A K-class star burning orange, the dependable engine of its court. Surface granulation churns visibly, and flare seasons come like clockwork. Shielding ratings for the inner worlds are set by its worst recorded outburst.

planets.name: Bittermoor
planets.description: Nitrogen glaciers creep under a sky the color of old bone. Subsurface warmth is rumored, and twice confirmed, and never shared. Salvage crews swear the comets arrive in formation, and the math almost agrees.

moons.name: Gilded Granite I
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Tidal stress warms its interior, and frost cracks map the strain. Outgassing vents frost the trailing face a little more each orbit.

planets.name: Obsidianspire
planets.description: A world-spanning sea hides all but a scatter of basalt teeth. Bioluminescent tides mark the shallows where the water runs warm. The guild maintains a listening post here, though no report has ever named its purpose.

moons.name: Storm Scree V
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Its surface records every era of bombardment the system ever knew. Outgassing vents frost the trailing face a little more each orbit.

moons.name: Pale Basalt I
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Its surface records every era of bombardment the system ever knew. Shepherd resonances with the rings betray a denser core than expected.

dwarfPlanets.name: Bitter Nether 87
dwarfPlanets.description: A small cold world holding its round shape against the dark. Frost plains stretch unbroken to a horizon that curves too soon. Its thin story is written entirely in impact craters.

asteroids.name: Scree 72
asteroids.description: A tumbling rock with a scarred face and a patient spin. Its regolith hides metal concentrations the assays prize. Outgassing cracks suggest ice beneath the dust mantle.

belts.name: Silent Trojans
belts.description: Countless fragments grind slowly against each other in a broad torus. Collisional dust hazes the lane, and larger bodies keep eccentric courts. Old mining claims dot the denser knots, most of them long expired.

comets.name: Wandering Shroud
comets.description: A dirty snowball falling sunward on its long appointed round. Each passage sheds glittering debris the scopes track for seasons. Its tail leans away from the star like a banner in a gale.
